kind: independent whole-source logical QUIC standards review
disposition: no new functional defect within inspected local-summary contract; narrow paragraph-grouping findings only

dependency_partial.limits: CPython Python JSONObject hook dispatch only; no accelerated C scanner/decoder, crypto or active runtime selection audited.

findings.problem: Read/decode error handling is adjacent to the separate schema stage; load-error handling is adjacent to comparison without an operation paragraph break.
findings.recommendation: If authorized, insert only blank lines between these phases; no logic/test change.

findings.problem: Format validation, independent list guards, conversion and guarded output run together despite the attached operation-grouping rule.
findings.recommendation: If authorized, separate independent guards and output with narrow paragraph breaks; no format/schema/API change.

examined: Duplicate JSON keys rejected via object_pairs_hook before dictionary collapse; read/parse/schema context retains original source by exception chaining.
Exact dict schemas and per-field validation reject boolean integers, invalid flags, unknown packet spaces/frame kinds, malformed coverage ranges and inconsistent declared completeness.
Summary parser reconstructs projection from supplied packets/spans, then requires exact equality with serialized logical flight, including retransmission telemetry.
Comparator requires all three spaces, nonempty complete markers, no terminal frames and exact marker fields/FIN; differences and bad input are not rendered as matches.
Marker interval merging excludes empty ranges, unions adjacent/overlapping ranges and tracks FIN separately; repeated zero-length FIN affects retransmission telemetry.
Eleven test methods use literal independent fragmentation/coverage/FIN/terminal differences; temp-file CLI tests include a coherent changed summary and duplicate-key refusal.
Imports/domain file responsibilities and concrete frozen dataclasses are appropriate; no justified crate/module split or new abstraction identified.
rejected_or_qualified_candidates: Serialized consistency is not authentication: local JSON may be constructed; byte-level authenticity/provenance is an upstream capture prerequisite.
Label policy describes allowed characters/reserved words, not secrecy; markers and overlap declarations remain supplied local-summary facts.

Direct typed constructors do not repeat all external JSON validators. Actual producer snippets show parsed STREAM fields and derived overlaps; arbitrary invalid direct constructor values are outside the inspected CLI boundary.
Comparator intentionally ignores packetization/ACK/PADDING/retransmission and absolute supplied stream locations beyond marker semantics; it is not a full frame/payload equality oracle.
Empty/self-equal unobserved flights are rejected by spaces/markers/incomplete checks; no zero-observation success established.
No local trusted-artifact size ceiling, complete QUIC RFC validator, browser parity claim or crypto validation was invented.
